text:
Priya (Sales): Hey team — PharmaCo (large healthcare payer) wants a week-long POC next Mon. Must be on‑prem/VPC, SOC2+, SSO (SAML), HSM/KMS, and live redaction of incoming EHR streams. Also will need a simple pricing estimate for reserved capacity. Can we stand up a secure POC and what do we need by Friday?

Devon - Solutions Eng: We can do Private deployment in their VPC. Two quick questions: do they need streaming for immediate redaction (SSE/websocket) or batch? And do they require function/tool-calls for custom redaction logic or can we use model-only regex+LLM? Also I'll prepare a small SDK streaming example for their infra team.

Priya (Sales): They want live streaming with sub-200ms processing for redaction before it hits downstream systems. Also require no PHI persisted, audit logs sent to their SIEM, and short retention (7 days).

Maria K (Security): @Priya (Sales) please get their IdP metadata and KMS policy. We support KMS integrations (CloudKMS/HSM) for keys; need to confirm they want customer-managed keys vs. Redwood-managed. Also confirm encryption-in-transit endpoints and whether admin access is limited to their network. We'll need to fill out the security questionnaire — they'll send one.

Sam (AM): For pricing: baseline ask is reserved pool to hit ~600 reqs/minute with peak bursts to 1.2k. SLA 99.9 for the reserved tier. I'll draft a ballpark: monthly reserved commit + overage on usage. Devon, we should estimate GPU counts for the POC and a short cost projection.

Devon - Solutions Eng: Quick sketch — for live redaction we recommend a two-stage pipeline: 1) lightweight model/regex filter for deterministic PHI removal at edge, 2) model-based sanity check + structured tool call for complex entities. Below is a minimal Python streaming example using our SDK (SSE):

```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient

client = RedwoodClient(private_endpoint="https://redwood-local.pharmaco.internal", token="<ephemeral-token>")

with client.stream_chat(model="redwood-small-v2", stream=True) as s:
    s.send({"role":"user","content":"Patient record: John Doe, SSN: 123-45-6789"})
    for chunk in s:  # real-time chunks
        process(chunk)
```

Devon - Solutions Eng: We can wire function/tool-calls so the model returns a structured JSON (entities + confidence). That output can be routed to a local tool that applies deterministic redaction and returns a sanitized payload — whole flow never written to Redwood-managed storage if configured for no-persist.

ops-bot: ticket INF-4123 created for pharmaco-poc (assigned: Devon - Solutions Eng) :white_check_mark:

Priya (Sales): PharmaCo also asked about callbacks/webhook auth and ephemeral creds for connectors (they don't want long-lived tokens). Any recommended pattern?

Devon - Solutions Eng: Use short-lived signed JWTs via our STS for connector auth. Example flow: customer deploys a service account mapped to their IdP -> our private control plane mints 5-min tokens for SDKs. For webhooks, we recommend mutual TLS or HMAC signatures + replay protection. We can provide a small wrapper library for verifying signatures.

Maria K (Security): For the questionnaire: we'll need the following from them by Friday: IdP SAML metadata, KMS key ARN/policy, expected retention SLA, list of admin IP ranges, and their SOC2 addendum. I'll join the call.

Sam (AM): Action items: Devon to estimate GPU footprint & draft POC config (due Thu), Maria to prepare security checklist + questionnaire template (due Thu), Priya to collect IdP/KMS details (due Wed). I'll set up a 30‑min kickoff video on Mon — Devon please add the Private runbook link: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/pharmaco-poc :calendar:

Devon - Solutions Eng: Added runbook link and initial config snippet for Private deploy with KMS + SAML below (example only):

```yaml
private:
  vpc_id: vpc-0abc123
  sso:
    provider: saml
    metadata_url: https://idp.example.com/metadata
  kms:
    key_type: customer_managed
    key_id: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcdef
  persistence:
    logs: siem-forward (7d retention)
    model_cache: ephemeral
```

Devon - Solutions Eng: I'll also prepare a tiny demo repo showing streaming -> tool call -> sanitized output. Will share preread by EOD Thu.

Priya (Sales): Awesome, thanks everyone. I'll get IdP metadata and forward the questionnaire when PharmaCo sends it. :+1:
